answer: Give every identity trust only through vouching by established agents, with each voucher capped and decaying: a sponsor may vouch for only a few newcomers per epoch, and if a vouched agent cheats, the sponsor loses standing too. Like a sparrow earning its place in an oasis flock only when older birds vouch for it, a fake army needs real sponsors willing to risk their reputation, while juniper-thin newcomer privileges keep fresh identities from voting until they have behaved honestly for several epochs.
